sn4.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭapabbate || || 2.
sn4.11:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā rattandhakāratimisāyam ajjhokāse nisinno hoti devo ca ekam ekam phusāyati || || 3.
sn4.11:1.3: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsam uppādetu-kāmo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato avidūre mahante mahante pāsāṇe padālesi || || 4.
sn4.11:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Māro ayam pāpimā iti viditvā Māram pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.11:4.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ Bhagavā jānāti maṃ Sugato ti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1.
